name: doll-game-promo
description: 30s vertical TikTok LIVE promo video built with Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render Promo out/_raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 --audio-bitrate=320k && npm run finalize
scripts.build: npm run audio && npm run render
scripts.finalize: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/_raw.mp4 -vf scale=in_range=full:out_range=tv,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 17 -profile:v high -level 4.2 -color_range tv -movflags +faststart -c:a copy out/promo.mp4 && rm out/_raw.mp4
